review.why: Writes teaching, school leadership and instructional design resumes with credentials and learner privacy kept accurate.
review.summary: Resume writing for teachers, student teachers, educational leaders, instructional designers and workplace trainers. A table lists the evidence to ask for per target. It keeps credential status, assessment evidence and completion rates distinct, and bars learner names and records.
strengths: Separates completion, satisfaction, assessment gains and job performance
Credential status kept exact: active, pending, expired
Learner privacy rules and a worked example without invented outcomes
cautions: Refers to other skills (career-change-resume, academic-cv) that may not be installed
